store.3: Career Path: Started at Goldman Sachs(2001) as analyst, gained M&A modeling experience and survived dot-com crash. First major deal: NeuralNet Systems IPO — Legend’s largest tech IPO to date. Built reputation for complex, cross-border transactions. Trust in finance is earned through proven track record and network.
store.4: Education & Philanthropy: Bachelor's in Economics from University of Pennsylvania; MBA from Harvard Business School(Baker Scholar). Active engagement with both institutions through guest lectures, student mentoring, and talent recruitment. Endowed a scholarship at Penn for first-generation finance students. Belief: Talent is the greatest investment in finance. Finance should be a pathway to opportunity—accessible to all who possess hunger and discipline.
